facts.fact: Decree No. 2.26.576 of 3 August 2026 strengthened the regulatory framework of the Startup Catalytic Fund, set up by the Ministry of Digital Transition and Administration Reform and managed by Tamwilcom, with $36 million public money over three years into venture capital funds, per The Morocco Post.

systems.owner: Ministry of Digital Transition and Administration Reform; managed by Tamwilcom

note: No investment by the funds yet; next phase is fundraising and startup selection.
